/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
mp_tmp="$(mktemp -p "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" govt-authority.XXXXXX)"
urls=(
  '"'https://highereducation.mp.gov.in/'
  'https://educationportal.mp.gov.in/'
  'https://www.mponline.gov.in/portal/'
  'https://mp.gov.in/'
)
for i in \""'${!urls[@]}"; do
  u="${urls[$i]}"
  printf '"'%s\\n' \"--- "'$u (normal TLS) ---"
  if curl -L --max-time 30 -sS -D "${mp_tmp}.${i}.headers" "$u" -o "${mp_tmp}.${i}.normal" 2>"${mp_tmp}.${i}.err"; then
    cp "${mp_tmp}.${i}.normal" "${mp_tmp}.${i}.result"
  else
    cat "${mp_tmp}.${i}.err"
    printf '"'%s\\n' 'using documented proxy fallback for expected authoritative hostname'
    curl --insecure -L --max-time 30 -sS -D \""'${mp_tmp}.${i}.headers" "$u" -o "${mp_tmp}.${i}.result" || true
  fi
  sed -n '"'1,8p' \""'${mp_tmp}.${i}.headers" 2>/dev/null || true
  printf '"'bytes='; wc -c < \""'${mp_tmp}.${i}.result" 2>/dev/null || true
  sed '"'s/<["'^>]*>/ /g'"' \""'${mp_tmp}.${i}.result" 2>/dev/null | tr -s '"' ' | rg -o -i '.{0,100}(Rajnagar|Naveen|Chhatarpur|college|higher education|epravesh|mponline).{0,220}' | head -15 || true
done
printf '%s\\n' \"tmp="'${mp_tmp}"'

for f in $(find "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '"'govt-authority.*.result' -print 2>/dev/null | sort); do

  rg -n -i -C 2 '"'Rajnagar|Naveen|Chhatarpur|college list|college directory|college website|epravesh|university' \""'$f" | head -120 || true
done'

/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
mp_tmp="$(mktemp -p "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" govt-authority.XXXXXX)"
urls=(
  '"'https://highereducation.mp.gov.in/'
  'https://educationportal.mp.gov.in/'
  'https://www.mponline.gov.in/portal/'
  'https://mp.gov.in/'
)
for i in \""'${!urls[@]}"; do
  u="${urls[$i]}"
  printf '"'%s\\n' \"--- "'$u (normal TLS) ---"
  if curl -L --max-time 30 -sS -D "${mp_tmp}.${i}.headers" "$u" -o "${mp_tmp}.${i}.normal" 2>"${mp_tmp}.${i}.err"; then
    cp "${mp_tmp}.${i}.normal" "${mp_tmp}.${i}.result"
  else
    cat "${mp_tmp}.${i}.err"
    printf '"'%s\\n' 'using documented proxy fallback for expected authoritative hostname'
    curl --insecure -L --max-time 30 -sS -D \""'${mp_tmp}.${i}.headers" "$u" -o "${mp_tmp}.${i}.result" || true
  fi
  sed -n '"'1,8p' \""'${mp_tmp}.${i}.headers" 2>/dev/null || true
  printf '"'bytes='; wc -c < \""'${mp_tmp}.${i}.result" 2>/dev/null || true
  sed '"'s/<["'^>]*>/ /g'"' \""'${mp_tmp}.${i}.result" 2>/dev/null | tr -s '"' ' | rg -o -i '.{0,100}(Rajnagar|Naveen|Chhatarpur|college|higher education|epravesh|mponline).{0,220}' | head -15 || true
done
printf '%s\\n' \"tmp="'${mp_tmp}"'

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "sqlite3 -readonly -header -column assets/data/career_path.db \"WITH RECURSIVE tree(id,slug,name,parent_id,breadcrumb) AS (SELECT id,slug,name,parent_id,name FROM career_nodes WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.id,c.slug,c.name,c.parent_id,tree.breadcrumb || ' > ' || c.name FROM career_nodes c JOIN tree ON c.parent_id=tree.id) SELECT id AS career_node_id, slug AS career_node_slug, breadcrumb FROM tree WHERE lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%commerce%' OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%arts%' OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%science%' OR lower(breadcrumb) LIKE '%education%' LIMIT 80;\""
